transaction.assistant_tutorial_body:
Easily create transactions by typing text here (or using your phone's dictation).

Expected format:
[search]  [amount?]  [description?]  [todo?]

1. The search looks in the name of your tags, categories and transaction-templates. It supports entering just part of the name and even getting some of the letters wrong.
elct => electricity

2. The amount supports mathematical expressions. Numbers separated by a space get automatically added up.

3. The description is optional. Use this to overwrite the default tag name.

4. The todo makes it easy to add the user defined "todo-tag" by appending a custom string(default "!!"). This can be changed in "Settings"

5. The date can be moved relative to today by typing +1d / -5d (plus or minus that many days) anywhere in the text.

Examples
"electricity" = tag
"swimming" = template

electricity 23
elc 12*2+33
elc 12+2*3 custom description
elc 25 !!
elc 25 -1d
swim

6. In the top-right there is a currency picker which you can change on the fly or set a default from "Settings" -> "Assistant". When used this will treat the amount as that currency and will convert the final value into your selected account currency. This can be really useful when going abroad.

profile_page.tutorial_body:
A profile is the collection of all the configurations found in the Settings pages.


You can have multiple profiles but only one can be active at a time. You can switch between them with a tap, and edit them via double-tap or long-tap


One use case is to have multiple defaults for the transaction-form: one for your daily usage and one for your vacation. The vacation profile can have a different source account, or have a tag called "Vacation August 2025" auto-applied. This makes it easy to see your total expense by that tag.
